description: Runtime settings (card M0-07, DECISIONS D5/D52). Read by backend/runtime/hub.py.
idle_tick_divisor_note: Engines nobody subscribes to tick at tick_rate_hz / idle_tick_divisor to save CPU/memory on small hosts; every subscribed engine ticks at full rate.
data_source_note: DIRECT (in-process simulation) now; CAN / MAVLINK / REPLAY sources arrive in M5-M7 behind the same Frame contract.
default_engine_id_note: Engine every client opens on first visit (Prasad 20 Nov 2026; D25/D47: the Rotax 912 iS Sport is the reference engine and first for demos). A ?engine= URL parameter or the user's later choice overrides it.
legacy_engine_id_note: Engine that the deprecated /api/state, /api/control and /ws/telemetry endpoints represent (card M0-08). They are adapters onto /api/v1 and go away when every client uses /api/v1.

security.note: DECISIONS D52. Command endpoints need the token when the env var is set (always set it when the server is reachable beyond this machine). Read-only endpoints stay open. CORS origins come from the env var (comma-separated); without it only the local dev origins are allowed, never '*'.

sim.note: DECISIONS D8: default 1x, selectable 1/5/20/60x. Plant integrates at internal_step_s; each published frame runs time_scale * (1/tick_rate_hz) / internal_step_s steps (R 21.3). 0.05 s keeps 60x affordable (60 steps per frame); fast first-order states (MAP, spool) use the exact exponential update so they stay stable at this step (T-PHY-9, T-PHY-11).
